findings.title: Interpolation hides `$__range` from the splitting guard
findings.body: This interpolates each expression before `querySupportsSplitting()` checks it with `isQueryWithRangeVariable()`. That check is explicitly meant to keep queries using `$__range` unsplit, because the variable must represent the full request range; after interpolation, the marker is gone, so the query is partitioned and executed with an expression containing the full-range value on each time chunk. This can produce incorrect results for range-dependent queries. Preserve the range-variable check against the original expression, or otherwise retain the non-splitting decision before interpolation.
